name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 7 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
